items.headline: "We view AI as a sliding scale. There will always be a human in the loop": Why Side signed an MOU with Modl.ai to use AI for QA
items.excerpt: Side and Modl.ai discuss the role of AI in games quality assurance, the tech's current limitations, and why human QA experts remain an essential part of the pipeline.

items.headline: Tencent Games Central Tech debuts at Gamescom 2026 with AI tools spanning animation, gameplay, and testing
items.excerpt: Tencent unveiled Motus, an AI pipeline for 3D animation, alongside GIGA and WeTest — a full-stack toolchain covering asset creation, gameplay and automated testing.

items.headline: New dev tool from Meta enables AI to quickly test Quest games
items.excerpt: Meta introduced Meta XR Operator, an experimental tool that lets AI coding agents autonomously build, test, debug and visually verify VR apps on Quest.

items.headline: 24% of Gamescom reveals officially used AI
items.excerpt: 23.64% of the games featured during Gamescom Opening Night Live this year disclosed AI use in development or marketing — 13 of 55 titles shown.

items.headline: Here are the Opening Night Live games you can ignore because of genAI slop
items.excerpt: A rundown of the Gamescom ONL titles whose Steam pages disclose generative AI, from Krafton's Tarae to NetEase's Ananta — some already known, many newly surfaced.

items.headline: The AI paradox: why mobile embraces AI and triple-A holds back
items.excerpt: At PGC Summit Shanghai, studio leaders and investors asked why free-to-play races to adopt AI in production while AAA studios hold back.

items.headline: Grand Theft Auto 6 will have no microtransactions or generative AI
items.excerpt: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson reportedly confirmed that no generative AI was used in GTA 6's development, and that the game ships without microtransactions.

items.headline: Rockstar Games' LA-based studio is 'dedicated almost solely' to the design of GTA 6's NPCs
items.excerpt: Rockstar reportedly staffed an entire studio around hand-authored NPC behaviour and reactivity for GTA 6 — a counterpoint to generative NPC pitches.

items.headline: Trails in the Sky's global publisher GungHo has no plans to use AI for localization
items.excerpt: GungHo says the complexity of the Trails universe, its huge cast and distinct speaking styles "still requires human judgement," ruling out AI translation for now.

items.headline: Penguin Colony gave me a genAI fright in its release date trailer, but there's no actual cause for concern
items.excerpt: RPS traces how a stylised trailer triggered AI-detection instincts, and what that reflex now costs small studios shipping hand-made art.
